status: PROPOSAL ONLY: review before validator implementation or format freeze
manifest: Exact Python types: booleans never accepted as numeric values; finite numbers only.
Name/author are Unicode scalar text <=96 scalars/384 UTF8 bytes; name non-whitespace. Description <=2048 UTF8 bytes.
Reject C0/C1 controls, bidi override/isolate controls and lone surrogates in metadata; newline/tab permitted only in description. No HTML interpretation.
UUID lower canonical RFC4122 variant/version4; never path, entitlement or overwrite authority.
SemVer <=64 chars, core values0..9999, no leading zeros on numeric prerelease IDs; correct SemVer ordering, metadata ignored.
style true; media iff any raster inclpreview; layout iff nonempty valid layout file; CSS iff nonempty UTF8 custom.css. Exact flags agree with archive.
Supported newer minimumVersion yields incompatible state; never activate, keep original bytes. Naming/requirements cannot invoke updater.
style: All omitted tokens/media properties use trusted defaults. Empty style object is valid foundation.
RGBA integer channels0..255; alpha0..1. Token lengths numeric part must satisfy x-vl bounds; no CSS functions or URLs in tokens.
Media asset or import-only source alias exactly one; normalize copy to asset, never mutate original archive.
Canonical asset name must exist in same snapshot; extension/signature/frame decode still pending and required for EVERY asset, including unused ones.
At most49 panelMedia slots and only registry-enabled iconSlots; appearance cannot position/hide/move any component.
Decorative media stays behind functional content; no foreign HTML, raw style strings, arbitrary fonts or SVG. Accessible reduced-motion preference wins.
layout: Every rule names registry.move=true component; unknown/structural/root/navigation/guide/page IDs rejected.
Parent defaults to registry.defaultParent; supplied parent must be registry.allowedLayoutParents. Effective graph includes all default relationships and must be acyclic.

hidden=true only registry.hide=true; pinned=true only pinAcrossPages=true. A supplied parent must be workspace when pinned; an omitted parent normalizes effective parent to workspace. No repeated instance.
A hide/pin-only rule omits mode and geometry, retaining trusted default placement. Pinning uses that default geometry in the workspace; unpin/reset restores origin parent, no file rewrite.
Supplied dimensions >=registry minimum; sidebar top/bottom dock uses minHeight64, minWidth160; nested containers maintain reviewed content minimums.
Dock edge must be registry.allowedDockEdges; currently all movable panels and sidebar permit four edges.
Grid column+span-1 <=workspace.columns (default12); row+span-1 <=64. Flow columnSpan<=columns. Stable ties order then registry index.
Control context remains origin workflow; explicit pin allows single same-context instance across pages. Children inherit pinned parent's visibility unless moved.
Grid collisions resolve deterministically by placing later registry instance in next free row, max64, otherwise temporary flow. No file rewrite.

Freeform stacking uses optional order0..1023 then registry index; keyboard focus raises that single panel temporarily. All controls lists every panel and can focus/bring forward an obscured panel, with native move/resize controls; no global shortcut replaces existing bindings.

Narrow form containers use viewport-bounded outer width, labels above controls and vertical scroll; authored minima stay saved but never force workspace horizontal scrolling. Canvases keep internal pan/zoom within viewport-bounded containers.
Freeform clamp/reflow on resize; negative right/bottom offsets represent inward distances. Temporary collision/clamp/flow fallback is visible in the builder, never rewrites package.
Optional hides retain native All controls unthemed reopen route; Start/Stop/policy/licensing/recovery remain native, never affected by layout.
appearanceCompositing: Canvas base is --vl-background. Background raster has fit/position, brightness/saturation/blur then raster-only opacity. Overlay is a separate layer with effective alpha colorAlpha*overlay.opacity.

Panel decorative raster lies behind its surface and functional content. Solid panel surface uses --vl-panel RGBA as sole alpha authority. When any gradient token is authored, a two-stop gradient REPLACES the solid surface, retaining each stop's own alpha; no doubled surface painting.

--vl-glass-strength controls backdrop blur effect, not alpha: effectiveBlur=min(40, --vl-blur*strength/0.68); default0.68 preserves authored blur. CSS backdrop-filter may replace a local surface blur but never stacks the same surface twice.
Functional content/focus/canvas coordinates are outside decorative opacity and transform. CSS font-family emits the chosen approved font PLUS Microsoft YaHei UI, Noto Sans, sans-serif fallback stack.

Native personal text size/reduced-motion preferences win. Theme font sizes are multiplied by personal text scale; focused/selected/disabled essentials retain trusted visible state outlines/markers and minimum44px targets.

wireTypes.integer: finite mathematical integral JSON number, including1/1.0/1e0; bool rejected. Normalize integral values and negative zero to integer in effective copy; limits small enough for exact browser representation.
wireTypes.number: finite mathematical JSON number; bool rejected; negative zero normalizes0
wireTypes.strings: Unicode scalar text; exact ASCII grammar for colors/units/versions/paths/IDs. Full-string matching with no trailing newline accepted. Patterns use[0-9], literal ASCIIspace only, never Python\d/\s.
wireTypes.defaults: Schema default and x-vl annotations are not validation. Cross-file semantic checks are mandatory and defaults apply to effective copy only; original archive unchanged.

metadataText.name: 1..96 scalar values, <=384UTF8bytes, at least one visible non-whitespace non-format character
metadataText.author: 0..96 scalar values, <=384UTF8bytes

effectiveDefaults.omittedBackground: separately bundled trusted Smokey Glass background; never an unvalidated archive member

layout.parent: registry defaultParent, or workspace when explicitly pinned and no parent supplied
layout.modeAbsent: trusted default placement: flow, registry index order, automatic size; hide/pin-only override retains it
layout.automaticSize: null width/height means foundation autosizing, with reviewed minima and narrow fallback; never zero or unbounded author override

filePresence.layout: layout.json present iff feature true; must pass nonempty schema (>=1component rule or workspace.columns)
filePresence.customCSS: custom.css present iff feature true; strictUTF8 and at least1non-ASCII-whitespace character. Comments-only nonempty CSS counts as present and compiles to empty CSS, kept in original.
filePresence.media: any assets raster or preview.webp member counts, including unused members; ALL must pass media stage
filePresence.incompatibleMinimumVersion: schema result records compatible=false with update-required reason; no activation or asset serving, original bytes retained; metadata cannot request/install an update
